concrete_notes: All changed hunks read: portal diff in three contiguous chunks, MCP first project-header hunk directly; every subsequent changed hunk text is identical after normalizing old/new line offsets, verified by exact ordered comparison. Declarations alone authorize none of these provider capabilities.

Portal trust-annotation settings remain maintained configuration; MCP queued-write and vetted-endpoint authority were not changed by these declaration hunks. New Memory/Browser/Search/AI type names must not bypass Context Gateway, human consent or protected local runtime boundary.
